title.en: GitHub Copilot CLI is now a supported agent
title.zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 现已成为受支持的 Agent

description.en: Install it from the marketplace and add it to a workspace. Sign in with your GitHub account — the agent turns Ready on its own once you do. On the Copilot Free plan, leave the model empty.
description.zh: 可从应用市场安装并加入工作区。使用 GitHub 账号登录即可，登录完成后 Agent 会自行变为就绪。若使用 Copilot Free 方案，请将模型留空。

description.en: Rename from the row's menu. An agent in a workspace is renamed on both sides. Clear the field to restore the original name.
description.zh: 在行内菜单中重命名。已加入工作区的智能体会两侧同步。清空输入框即可恢复原名。

title.en: Signing in no longer opens a spare empty terminal window
title.zh: 登录时不再多出一个空白终端窗口

title.en: Removing an agent now removes it from its workspace too
title.zh: 移除智能体时会一并从工作区移除

description.en: No need to remove it a second time from the workspace itself.
description.zh: 不再需要另外到工作区中移除一次。

title.en: Leaving a workspace now leaves it on both sides
title.zh: 退出工作区现在会在两侧同时生效

description.en: The agent stays here, ready to join another workspace.
description.zh: 智能体保留在本机，可加入其他工作区。

title.en: Agent row actions stay in one place at any window size
title.zh: 智能体行内的操作按钮位置不再随窗口变化

description.en: Configure has moved into the row menu, where actions are grouped by what they do.
description.zh: 「配置」已移入行内菜单，菜单中的操作按性质分组。
